observations: A four-legged animal form occupies the center against a flat teal field; its body is outlined in black with a lowered head at right and an arched spine rising to a curved neck at upper left.
Looping lines in yellow, red-orange, and white run along the torso and neck, while pale blue pooling shapes sit beneath the hooves.
A zigzag white line traces the top of the curved neck, and loose red lines at upper left end in small circular loops, hanging free of the main body outline.
reading: The animal reads as burdened or braced — head dropped, spine arched, legs planted wide. Warm looping lines layered across the body suggest exposed inner workings rather than surface decoration. The white zigzag ridge along the neck adds a raw, almost sutured quality. Blue pooling beneath the feet gives the figure a sense of standing in something it cannot move through.
